question: The Indian Constitution originally consisted of ________ Articles.
solution:
The correct answer is __**395.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Constitution originally consisted of **395 articles.**
 
• This number has since been amended several times, and currently the Indian Constitution has **448 articles.**
 
• Important sections of the Indian Constitution,** legislatures, executive branches, schedules, constitutional bodies, statutory bodies, fundamental rights,** and more are covered in each set of articles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Constitution is the** longest written constitution **of any sovereign country in the world.
 
• It was adopted on** November 26, 1949**, and came into effect on **January 26, 1950.**
 
• The Constitution originally had **22 parts**, but this number has since been revised to** 25 parts.**
 
• The Constitution also includes **12 schedules,** which contain various lists and tables related to important topics such as** languages, territories, and elections.**
